title: Spend-Per-Season Fashion Budget
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wardrobe:item event=purchase
| bin _time span=3mon
| stats sum(price) as spend, count as items by _time
| eval budget=300, over=if(spend>budget,1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks clothing spend each season against a budget, keeping fashion enthusiasm within your means.
value: Seasonal clothing spend creeps up unnoticed; a budget check keeps a wardrobe habit affordable.
implementation: Ingest purchases into `index=personal`; total spend per season against a budget.
visualization: Column chart of seasonal clothing spend with a budget line.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks what you spend on clothes each season against a budget, keeping fashion affordable.
